show.description: When Ethan D’Costa, an impoverished tea seller, makes a Faustian bargain with a secret group who worship a demon to give his daughter the life she deserves, he rises overnight to unimaginable wealth and power. But as his past, his estranged wife, and the ruthless Poonawala empire resurface, Ethan must fight to protect his daughter at all costs—before the demon returns to claim his soul. Watch Now.
